rv.q: “Waitress” wears its flaws on its uniform sleeve, but the naked honesty of Mueller’s singing is enough to make an overscheduled theater critic wish that the curtain would never come down.
A tourist-trap rom-com that has little to offer but Ms. Mueller and her fine supporting cast.
And that is why I will go to Tower Records (gotcha) and get the cast recording.
And in this case, I suspect some viewers will be coming back for seconds.
Ultimately the music, lyrics and performances are so rich that these nits are minor distractions in an otherwise engaging show.
Which is pretty much how you are likely to feel after seeing “Waitress.”
It’s worth seeing but you needn’t go out of your way to overpay for a ticket.
Bareilles needs to learn that one musical size does NOT fit all musical theater characters.
